subject.title: [Bug]: Browser interactions can exhaust model context by injecting too much page content

question: Should browser snapshot and action defaults move to compact goal-shaped reads and post-action change reports, and what explicit escape hatch should remain for full raw page reads?
rationale: The source shows partial caps and optional efficient mode, but making compact browser reads the default changes model-facing browser behavior and needs maintainer intent plus live calibration.

options.title: Default compact browser reads
options.body: Make compact interactive snapshots and small post-action change reports the default while preserving explicit full snapshot or maxChars requests for raw page inspection.

options.title: Keep efficient mode opt-in
options.body: Leave current defaults in place and improve docs or skills so users choose efficient snapshots for noisy browser tasks.

options.title: Split by live repro
options.body: Require a focused live browser benchmark before choosing the permanent default and break the work into narrower follow-up issues.

recommendation.title: Default compact browser reads
recommendation.body: Make compact interactive snapshots and small post-action change reports the default while preserving explicit full snapshot or maxChars requests for raw page inspection.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent browser action contract work is the closest history signal for choosing action-result and snapshot interaction semantics.
